maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: Northstar banner artwork and frozen Apex display textures are added. Authored RGB paint is recovered on existing surfaces. Animated Hammond graphics, some control-room colouring and scenery remain incomplete. Intro and evac are disabled.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: Green Apex building displays and additional source display textures are restored as static artwork. Gold tunnel paint is recovered. Some scenery and layered materials remain approximated. The tunnel catwalks are a Titanfall addition.
